blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo Lacson suggested keeping livestream cameras rolling even when budget deliberations are suspended to prevent corruption from creeping into the 2027 budget measure. His proposal was specifically aimed at bicameral conference committee proceedings. “When the budget bill reaches the bicam, as what happened last year, there were many suspensions where lawmakers were whispering in a corner, away from the cameras. So I’d like to propose that in the bicam, the cameras keep rolling even during a suspension of the proceedings so the public will know what is being discussed,” he said in an interview on radio dwIZ […]...
